The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mamendin]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ferus Olin]] impersonated the [[Slams]], a criminal gang composed of members of this species.<ref name="JCG" />
